messages:
Alex Kim: Quick sync — Acme pilot just asked for per-tenant prompt-store + streaming embeddings in MVP. They want it in the pilot by Dec 12. This would affect our latency/cost SLOs. Thoughts?
Priya Shah: flagged. How big is the delta? Are they asking per-tenant isolation or just logical tagging?
Alex Kim: per-tenant isolation (separate stores + KMS). They also want embeddings endpoint proxied per-tenant.
Marco Alvarez: oof. Isolation + KMS adds infra/backfill work. Rough eng estimate: 3 wks infra, 1 wk api, + QA + rollout. Can we scope down?
Sam O'Neill: we can do logical tagging as interim (single store, tenant prefix + ACL) — saves KMS. That cuts time to ~1.5wks.
Taylor Reed: tl;dr — two paths:
``` 
A) Full isolation (MVP): infra+KMS+RBAC — ETA Dec 12 (high risk)
B) Logical tagging (MVP): single store + tenant prefixes — ETA Nov 30 (lower risk) -> full isolation in v1
```
Priya Shah: Constraints: sales says pilot contract expects isolation. Legal requires KMS for enterprise data. Can't ship pilot without KMS for Acme.
Marco Alvarez: if legal + sales must have KMS, then we either push pilot or compress other scope.
Alex Kim: options:
- Push pilot by 2 weeks (safe)
- Compress MVP: cut embeddings streaming (non-critical), keep per-tenant KMS
- Offer Acme a limited pilot with redacted data (privacy band-aid)
Taylor Reed: propose cutting embeddings streaming from MVP and shipping KMS+isolation. That keeps pilot in contract and reduces infra scope.
Sam O'Neill: agrees: embeddings streaming deferred to v1. We can add an embargoed TODO and toggle in config.
Priya Shah: customer signals + legal lean toward isolation. I vote ship per-tenant KMS in MVP, move embeddings streaming to v1. 
Alex Kim: decision (for now): per-tenant KMS in MVP, embeddings streaming -> v1. Taylor will update milestone tracker and notify sales/legal.
Taylor Reed: updated milestone board:
``` 
MVP - target: Dec 1
- Per-tenant KMS + isolation: in
- Embeddings streaming: deferred -> v1
- QA + Rollout: 1 week after infra
```
Taylor Reed: @Marco can you confirm infra spike and add tasks? 
Marco Alvarez: will add tickets: INFRA-1203, INFRA-1204, KMS-setup, tenant-migrations. ETA for infra spike: 7 business days.
Alex Kim: thanks all. @release-bot schedule a soft freeze Nov 24 -> Dec 2 for this deliverable :pray:
release-bot: scheduled soft freeze window 1705800000 -> 1706400000 (unix ts). :robot_face:
Priya Shah: I'll draft communication to Acme and Sales with the plan.
Sam O'Neill: adding a feature-flag for embeddings streaming so we can flip it once ready.
Alex Kim: nice. We'll re-evaluate if risks change. Closing thread.
